title: diagnose_job inputSchema
description: Read-only diagnosis of a caller-readable geoprocessing job, separating recorded observations, inferred explanations, and evidence gaps. Honua extension (#6219), advertised as honua_diagnose_job. This reference contract is not a finalized geospatial-mcp standard tool.

jobId.description: Identifier of a geoprocessing job the caller can read (from a submission result or honua_list_jobs).

events.description: How many of the most recent recorded events to include in observed.events.
